scope: Refresh current open-source DWG/DXF/3D peer release and development-branch boundaries; update existing PAR-07/S2/S3/S8 peer-admission readiness without inferring local behavior or promoting support claims.

method.kind: Primary upstream release, source, issue, and pull-request review
method.freshnessLimit: The exact merge SHA/status of ACadSharp PR #1270 was not independently resolved. GitHub issue #822 shows closed as completed through #1270 after the v3.8.0 release; the issue-close event is not treated as a peer runtime result.
method.evidenceRule: A release/tag, mutable master, pull-request branch, issue closure, or project-reported corpus result is version- and route-scoped. None alone establishes libdxfrw correctness, complete entity support, exact owner attachment, valid B-rep semantics, or native CAD acceptance.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp release and read-side ACIS/Prototype1b route
evidence.observed: v3.8.0 is signed at commit 3a1c66b. The v3.6.51 release notes list #1139 raw ACIS payload extraction for 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY across DWG and DXF, #1146 payload-area anchoring, and #1154 full DWG Prototype1b parsing. #1139 describes an author-reported 306-file corpus and more than 16,000 extracted payloads, with a multi-blob limitation at that stage. #1154 describes remaining unknown values and read-only scope for its Prototype1b data model.
doesNotEstablish: complete support across all producers, versions, schemas, or blob layouts
ACIS DXF writer capability in v3.8.0
evidence.planUse: Admit v3.8.0 only as an optional, exact-pinned read-side structural comparator. Check raw payload identity and per-entity owner attachment on locally authored controls; separate carrier extraction from semantic geometry.

evidence.topic: Post-release ACadSharp development and writer status
evidence.observed: Issue #822 is closed as completed through PR #1270 after the v3.8.0 tag; the exact merged commit was not resolved. PR #1174 remains open; a contributor reported an owner-attachment test failure on that branch, not on the released package. PR #1240 remains open, depends on #1174, and shows no deployment. Issue #1195 describes silent modeler-entity omission on ACadSharp 3.4.9, not a reproduced v3.8.0 failure.
doesNotEstablish: a general current-master ACIS writer capability
successful arbitrary-schema write or native acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep released-v3.8.0, exact current-master commit, and open-PR builds as separate comparison lanes. Before any newer-source run, resolve immutable SHAs and pass a focused owner-attachment test. Do not infer writer support from the issue closure.

evidence.observed: The latest visible prerelease is 0.14.8612 at f860b0f, dated Oct 13 and labeled a Windows nightly/pre-release. Project documentation continues to describe advanced R2010+ read omissions and DWG writer/version caveats, including stable writing limited through R2004 and CRC/audit problems for R2010-R2018 output.
doesNotEstablish: a new stable release with changed capability
uniform entity-family success from a broad version-coverage statement
evidence.planUse: Pin stable and prerelease artifacts separately; report version, entity family, direction, owner path, and outcome. No headline coverage percent promotes local support.

evidence.topic: DXF comparator and downstream-consumer route boundaries
evidence.observed: GDAL 3.12 adds Binary DXF reading and an AC1027+ option exposing raw ASM bytes and a 12-real transform; modeler entities are skipped by default and are not made into OGR solids. ezdxf 1.4.5 documents selected SAT/SAB read/write and flat-polygon mesh extraction, but warns unsupported ACIS structures may be lost. FreeCAD documents distinct C++ and legacy Python DXF importer paths and requires an external DWG converter.
doesNotEstablish: an independent open-source DWG parser in GDAL
arbitrary curved B-rep support in ezdxf
one uniform FreeCAD import result across backends or converter versions
native CAD acceptance from file-open success
evidence.planUse: Keep GDAL raw ASM, ezdxf bounded carrier/projection, and named FreeCAD importer/converter routes separate. Capture backend, converter, skipped bodies, warnings, and projection/semantic outcome explicitly.

optionalPeerGateOrder: Continue with local generated vectors and focused tests; no peer is required for an ordinary implementation slice.
At the composed checkpoint, prefer a released, immutable ACadSharp package for raw read/owner checks; resolve and pin any post-release master or PR source separately.
Run DXF inline SAT, DXF ACDSDATA/SAB, pre-AC1027 DWG inline modeler data, and AC1027+ DWG Prototype1b/AcDs as separate carrier profiles.
Compare source entity/handle and owner path to exact payload length/hash and peer notifications; counts or successful parse status alone do not establish attachment.
Only after carrier and owner closure may ACIS parser, kernel, analytic metrics, or named-native-consumer gates run.
